evidence.source_statement: For long-running processes or stateful CLI/GUI applications, verify required termination, cancellation, resource release and preservation of pending valuable work on normal exit and relevant interruption paths.
source_conditions: An authorized Rust project is being created from scratch and the specified concern is part of its accepted purpose or supported user contract.
